newsitem.title: USA: Musicland December same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Musicland December same store sales up.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said Thursday that same store sales for the five-week period ended January 4 rose 2.2 percent.
Total sales for that period rose 2.6 percent to $424.1 million, compared with $413.4 million for the year-ago period ended December 30, 1995.
For the nine weeks of November and December, ended January 4, comparable store sales rose 2.9 percent.
Musicland said that, comparing the five-week period ended January 4 with the five-week period ended January 6, 1996, its same store sales would have increased eight percent.

The company said the rise in its same store sales were due to better inventory in-stock positions, more targeted advertising and the impact of liquidation sales in 18 Media Play stores in late December. These liquidation sales increased the company's comparable-store sales in December by 1.8 percentage points, Musicland said.

The increase in total sales was fueled by the Superstores Division, which includes Media Play and On Cue, where sales grew 12.4 percent. Comparable-store sales for this division increased 10.8 percent.
Sales for the Mall Stores Division, including Sam Goody and Suncoast Motion Picture Company, decreased 2.2 percent with comparable-store sales down 1.6 percent.

Musicland's sales increased six percent for the 52 weeks ended January 4, 1997, to $1.8 billion from $1.7 billion in the same period last year. Comparable-store sales year-to-date declined 0.4 percent.
